description: Update an authored component's complete version-4 source/metadata IN PLACE (same id) — the correct verb for the author→preview→fix loop (preview_component returns the admission or runtime error; fix the template here and re-preview, instead of creating a new component each iteration). Pass componentId + the changed fields as `body`. Same source contract as create_component: {version:4, componentId, template, manifest, definition}, admitted before the write; the template finds its root with document.getElementById('root'), and declared slots arrive in the scene's `assets`, never params. PLACED CLIPS: every placed clip renders the exact version it pins, so an update moves placed clips ONLY when you name a project — put `projectId` (and optionally `compositionId`; default the project's active composition) in `body`, and that composition's placements move to the new version in the same write. The answer carries `repinned` (what moved) and `placementsPinnedToPrevious` (placements across the org still rendering the previous version). Without `projectId` nothing placed moves: previews and renders of an existing clip keep the old version. For one placement, register the source WITHOUT projectId, read its immutable sourceVersionId, then use apply_composition clip.update to change only the selected clip source and exact pin under observed concurrency expectations. Explicit-project update_component admits and repins all matching placements in that composition; use it only when that broader edit is requested.

__schema0.description: Caller-chosen stable component id. On create it names the new component. On PUT/PATCH it is optional and, when present, must equal the id in the path; a mismatch is a 400 naming both.

__schema19.description: Exact source head observed before adoption, editing or rollback. A changed head refuses the write; project placements remain pinned unless explicitly guarded below.

__schema20.description: A project whose explicitly named composition moves its placements atomically with the source write. Requires compositionId and concurrency.

__schema21.description: The exact composition observed by the caller. Required with projectId and concurrency.

__schema22.description: Caller-observed placement guard, required with projectId and compositionId: a placement update without it is refused with 428 precondition_required. Atomic library edits with placement changes require explicit supported invocation admission.

__schema8.description: Usage examples, as authored. A built-in primitive projects {name, mood?, params?, description?}; an authored component's examples are whatever it wrote, which is why the item is open. One shape for both directions: what you write here is what you read back.

body.description: PUT /components/:id body: every writable field, all optional; an omitted field is carried forward. Org/user are server-resolved; never accepted from the body.

source.description: Call describe_tool_input with tool "update_component" and field "source" for the exact JSON Schema.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: update_component

avoidWith.description: Authoring guidance: ids of primitives that CONFLICT with this one — do not place together.

brandBindings.description: Params that can follow the project brand kit. Each {param, brandToken} says: set `param` to `brandToken` (a `$brand:` ref, e.g. '$brand:colors.accent') to track the brand instead of a literal. See the list response's `brandTokens` for the full ref vocabulary. Omitted when nothing is brand-bound.

examples.description: Usage examples, as authored. A built-in primitive projects {name, mood?, params?, description?}; an authored component's examples are whatever it wrote, which is why the item is open. One shape for both directions: what you write here is what you read back.

fixedCopy.description: On-screen strings this primitive BAKES — the read-side counterpart to propSchema. These literals render REGARDLESS of params (no param can change them); fork the source via get_component_source to edit them. Use this to see at author time what fixed copy (someone-else's marketing text, faux-code, faux-data) will appear before you render.

id.description: The entry's id: a `primitiveId` for a built-in, a `componentId` for an installed component.

intent.description: Selection signal: a verb naming what this primitive accomplishes (e.g. 'product-trailer'). Match it to the beat you are authoring.

kind.description: RENDER kind (component | transition | scene). NOT the ClipSource variant — see `placement` for how to author it on the timeline.

mood.description: Vibe/tone tags (e.g. 'cinematic', 'minimal'). Filter to match the edit's mood.

pairsWith.description: Authoring guidance: ids of primitives that COMPOSE well with this one in the same edit.

placementsPinnedToPrevious.description: Placements across the org that still pin the previous version and will keep rendering it. Name `projectId` (and `compositionId`) on the update to move a composition's placements with it.

repinned.description: Present when the update named `projectId`: the composition whose placements moved to the new version.

source.description: 'default' = built-in primitive (place by primitiveId); 'installed' = org-authored component (place by componentId).

subtextParam.description: The param field for secondary text (subtitle/byline); null = none.

textParam.description: The param field that carries this primitive's primary text; null = no single text slot.

tier.description: Quality/applicability RANKING (a preference, not a flag). Prefer 'recommended'; reach for 'niche' only when its specific use-case is exactly the beat.

useCase.description: The edit ROLE(s) this primitive fills — the dimension to filter by for a beat (e.g. 'intro', 'title-over-footage', 'grade').

useWhen.description: When to use this — AND when not to. The negative guidance is load-bearing; read it before picking.

version.description: The ENTRY's version: a semver string ('0.0.0' until an authored component is versioned). Distinct from `manifest.version`, which is the runtime contract version (4 native, 2 retired TSX).

warnings.description: Non-blocking save-time advisories — the create/update SUCCEEDED. Currently: a `fontFamily` string literal referencing a NON-vendored font (a bare CSS generic like 'serif', or an unknown named family like 'Arial') whose LIVE-lane pixels vary by render host — re-author with a vendored family or 'Georgia'. Omitted when there is nothing to flag; only present on the create/update responses.
